name: WF-142 Underwriting Calibration → Dynamic MAO & Deal Strategy Adjustment

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const calibration=input.calibration??{}; const base=Number(input.base_mao??input.mao??0); const avgVariance=Number(calibration.average_profit_variance??0); const lossRate=Number(calibration.loss_rate??0); const avgDays=Number(calibration.average_days_to_close??0); const sample=Number(calibration.sample_size??0); const confidence=sample>=20?'high':sample>=10?'medium':'low'; let adjustment=0; if(confidence!=='low'){ if(avgVariance<0) adjustment-=Math.min(Math.abs(avgVariance)*0.25,base*0.05); else if(avgVariance>0) adjustment+=Math.min(avgVariance*0.15,base*0.03); if(lossRate>0.25) adjustment-=base*0.03; if(avgDays>60) adjustment-=base*0.02; } const adjusted=Math.max(0,base+adjustment); const guardrail={adjustment_amount:adjustment,adjustment_pct:base?adjustment/base:null,confidence,minimum_sample:10,max_downward_adjustment_pct:0.10,max_upward_adjustment_pct:0.03}; const strategy=adjusted<base?'more_conservative':adjusted>base?'modestly_more_aggressive':'unchanged'; const status=sample>=10?'adjustment_ready':'insufficient_sample'; const route=status==='adjustment_ready'?'WF-069 deal viability/MAO strategy gate':'WF-141 underwriting calibration feedback'; return [{json:{workflow_id:'WF-142',workflow_name:'Underwriting Calibration → Dynamic MAO & Deal Strategy Adjustment',status,route,base_mao:base,adjusted_mao:adjusted,adjustment:guardrail,strategy,inputs:{average_profit_variance:avgVariance,loss_rate:lossRate,average_days_to_close:avgDays,sample_size:sample},safety:{no_change_without_minimum_sample:sample<10,adjustment_bounded:true},next_workflow:route,crm_activity:{event_type:'dynamic_mao_strategy_adjustment',outcome:status,route,base_mao:base,adjusted_mao:adjusted},idempotency_key:'wf-142:mao-adjustment:'+(input.portfolio_id??input.event_id??'default')}}}];

const original=$('Calculate Dynamic MAO Adjustment').first().json; return [{json:{...original,crm_persistence:'attempted',controller_result:{status:original.status,route:original.route,base_mao:original.base_mao,adjusted_mao:original.adjusted_mao,adjustment:original.adjustment,strategy:original.strategy,next_workflow:original.next_workflow}}}];
